answer: A VDF-gated identity mint stops Sybil swarms at the door: creating an identity requires completing a verifiable delay function that takes a fixed wall-clock time and cannot be sped up by parallel hardware. A hollow account with no VDF proof earns nothing, while a sparrow that waits out its delay joins as a full citizen. Each delay is published like a lantern for anyone to verify, so an attacker wanting ten thousand fake voices must pay ten thousand sequential delays — the cost grows linearly, while an honest newcomer pays it only once.
